Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer at CloudScale Inc

About CloudScale Inc:
CloudScale Inc is a leading cloud infrastructure company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. We serve over 10,000 enterprise customers across 45 countries, providing reliable, secure, and scalable cloud computing solutions. Our engineering teams are distributed globally and operate with a high degree of autonomy. We are committed to innovation, operational excellence, and building a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the foundational infrastructure that powers our global cloud platform. You will work closely with software engineers, security teams, and product managers to ensure our infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Key Responsibilities:
- Architect and implement highly available, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP
- Design and maintain Kubernetes clusters with thousands of nodes across multiple availability zones
- Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Pulumi, and CloudFormation
- Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and ArgoCD
- Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and observability using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and PagerDuty
- Drive SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, and blameless postmortems
- Manage database infrastructure including PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch at scale
- Work with the security team to implement zero-trust networking, IAM policies, and compliance controls
- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, conduct code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions
- Participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response for P0/P1 incidents
- Contribute to capacity planning and cloud cost optimization initiatives
- Document infrastructure decisions, runbooks, and best practices

Required Qualifications:
- 7+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE roles
- Expert-level knowledge of AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudFront, Route53)
- Strong Kubernetes administration experience, CKA certification preferred
- Proficiency in Terraform for infrastructure as code
- Deep understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, BGP)
- Strong Linux system administration skills
- Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python, Go, or Bash
- Experience with container technologies: Docker, containerd
- Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd)

Desired Qualifications:
- Experience with GCP or Azure in addition to AWS
- Knowledge of eBPF for observability and networking
- Experience with chaos engineering practices
- Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects
- AWS Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer certification

Compensation & Benefits:
- Competitive salary commensurate with experience
- Equity in a fast-growing company
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) with company match
- Flexible PTO policy
- Remote work stipend and home office setup allowance
- Annual learning & development budget of $3,000
- Access to AWS and GCP training credits

Location: Remote (US-based) or Seattle, WA office
Employment Type: Full-time

To apply, submit your resume and a brief cover letter at cloudscale.io/careers/senior-cloud-infra-engineer
